title: Life and pensions foundations
objective: the value of the Life and Pensions sector to society and the economy
key customer needs relating to pensions, protection, investments and savings
a range of potential solutions available to meet customer needs
how individuals and organisations work as a profession to treat customers fairly and meet their needs effectively

outcomes.title: Understand the role and value of financial services, including the Life and Pensions sector

objectives.text: Identify the key features of the financial services sector and its role in the economy.
Outline key concepts of risk and the social value of insurance.
Outline the UK pensions system.

outcomes.title: Understand typical customer financial needs and expectations

objectives.text: Outline the stages of the typical customer lifecycle (the personal financial lifecycle) and associated financial needs.
Identify what key information is gathered from a customer to establish their financial needs.

outcomes.title: Understand financial protection products and their role in customer solutions

objectives.text: Outline the main types of life assurance and their uses.
Outline the main types of health and income protection products and their uses.

outcomes.title: Understand savings and investment products and their role in customer solutions

objectives.text: Identify the functions served by savings and investment products.
Outline the main types of savings and investment products and their tax treatment.
Identify fund types and uses.

outcomes.title: Understand pensions and their role in customer solutions

objectives.text: Outline the main types of pension and their benefits.

outcomes.title: Know the main retirement income options

objectives.text: Outline the main retirement income options.

outcomes.title: Understand how Life and Pensions firms operate

objectives.text: Identify definitions and features of different life and pensions distribution and advisory models.
Outline how Life and Pensions firms gain income and maintain financial stability.

outcomes.title: Understand key principles of delivering good customer service

objectives.text: Outline the main customer service functions and procedures.
Identify the main communication approaches and their key advantages.

Outline the main customer service techniques for eliciting information; rapport and empathy; clear communication; recognising vulnerable customers; dealing with challenging situations; recognising and responding fairly to diversity of backgrounds, characteristics and levels of understanding.
Outline the role and stages of the complaints process.

outcomes.title: Understand ethical, legal and regulatory principles and duties in the context of life insurance and pensions

objectives.text: Identify key aspects of legislation: insurance law; data protection; anti-money laundering; Equality Act.
Outline the UK regulators and their role in protecting customers and industry standards.
Identify the features of professional, ethical and inclusive conduct and the consequences of different standards of conduct.
